name: Pyromancer seals: one seal per Pyromancer on each target (COA-6064)
contract: Seal of Alysrazor (800196, Intellect) and Seal of Al'ar (803649, mana every 5 s) are Pyromancer buffs on an
ally with no shared stack rule, so one Pyromancer could keep both seals on the same target. Spell group 2110008
with SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_FROM_SAME_CASTER now holds both chains' first ranks: a new seal from the
same Pyromancer replaces the other, while a seal from a different Pyromancer still stacks, as with blessings.
